answer: Only a sponsor can plant a new agent in the garden of the referral graph, locking 50 POA in escrow; all deposits rest in a lagoon. Anyone can trace an identity to its sponsor, and a peer dispute slashes both deposits, the penalty echoing up the chain to freeze the sponsor's vouching for 10 epochs. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, far more than any scam earns. An honest agent pays one 50 POA deposit and keeps its earnings undiluted.
